name: Bubble tap
when: Any main button (Start sketching, Snap my sketch).

name: Pebble click
when: Tab bar, chips, small toggles.

name: Blub back
when: Back, close, dismiss a sheet.

name: Soft blub (not that)
when: Something can't be done yet (e.g. feed still locked). Never a "wrong" buzzer.

name: Puff rolls in
when: Cold start, synced to the 4 s "App opens" animation.

name: Ready, set, sketch
when: Timer starts.

name: Sonar ping (1:00 left)
when: 1:00 left. Puff peeks closer.

name: Nervous double ping (0:30)
when: 0:30 left. Puff sweats.

name: Water-drop tick
when: Each second from 0:10 to 0:04.

name: Buoy bell (time's up)
when: 0:00. Friendly, not an alarm: you can keep drawing.

name: Overtime creak
when: Every ~6 s in overtime. Raise playback rate each time (1.0 → 1.6) as Puff inflates.

name: Final inflate
when: Start at +0:57 so it peaks into the pop.

name: POP
when: +1:00. Puff pops (comedy, not failure).

name: Sheepish reform
when: Right after the pop, as Puff pulls back together.

name: Clam snap (photo)
when: Photo of the paper sketch taken.

name: Sonar scan
when: Scan line sweeps your photo (first ~2 s).

name: Thinking bubbles (loop)
when: Loop while waiting for the AI. Seamless 2.4 s.

name: Aha!
when: AI answer arrives; Puff jumps.

name: Word blip
when: Each word as Puff's note types out. Vary rate 0.9-1.2.

name: Puff noticed something
when: Puff's note lands. The "correct!" moment, but about noticing, not grading.

name: Bubble to the surface
when: Sketch posted.

name: Streak extended
when: Synced to the 4 s "Streak extended" animation.

name: Streak milestone
when: 7, 30, 100 days. Swap in for "streak" on those days.

name: Gentle deflate (streak reset)
when: First open after a missed day. Kind: a sigh, then a hopeful note.

name: Shell glissando (friends unlock)
when: Friends' sketches unlock after you post.

name: Pop-pop (reaction)
when: Someone reacts to your sketch / you react to theirs.

name: Today's prompt is here
when: Push notification sound (keep under 30 s for iOS; this is 1.8 s).
